# Place Naming

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PlaceNaming`](gmeow-PlaceNaming.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PlaceNaming>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A DEFINED specialization of [`gmeow:NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md) whose named entity is a [`gmeow:Place`](gmeow-Place.md) — a time/audience/register-scoped use of a toponym. Defined, NOT asserted: any [`NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md) that names a [`Place`](gmeow-Place.md) is inferred to be a [`PlaceNaming`](gmeow-PlaceNaming.md) (≡ [`gmeow:NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md) ⊓ ∃[`gmeow:usageNamed`](../properties/gmeow-usageNamed.md).[`gmeow:Place`](gmeow-Place.md)), so place-naming reuses the [`NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md) relator instead of minting a parallel relator ([Principle 6](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-6), greenfield/no-redundancy). The reified counterpart of [CIDOC-CRM](../../external/ontologies.md#target-crm)'s time-spanned [crm:E48](http://www.cidoc-crm.org/cidoc-crm/E48) [`Place`](gmeow-Place.md) Name / [crm:E41](http://www.cidoc-crm.org/cidoc-crm/E41) [`Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md). Competing and historical place names coexist as co-equal PlaceNamings with no primary; superseded ones set [`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)). The toponymic authority is [`gmeow:usageAuthority`](../properties/gmeow-usageAuthority.md); the name's language is [`gmeow:nameLanguage`](../properties/gmeow-nameLanguage.md) on the bound [`gmeow:PlaceName`](gmeow-PlaceName.md) (reached via [`gmeow:usageAppellation`](../properties/gmeow-usageAppellation.md)).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use (by inference) for a time-, audience-, or authority-scoped use of a toponym — a competing, historical, or authority-conferred place name that needs its own period, toponymic authority, or standpoint.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting [`PlaceNaming`](gmeow-PlaceNaming.md) directly (it is inferred from a [`NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md) whose [`gmeow:usageNamed`](../properties/gmeow-usageNamed.md) is a [`gmeow:Place`](gmeow-Place.md)) and avoid minting a parallel place-naming relator — reuse [`gmeow:NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md) ([Principle 6](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-6)); never rank one place-naming as primary.

### How to use

- Mint a [`gmeow:NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md) binding [`gmeow:usageNamed`](../properties/gmeow-usageNamed.md) (a [`Place`](gmeow-Place.md)) and [`gmeow:usageAppellation`](../properties/gmeow-usageAppellation.md) (a [`gmeow:PlaceName`](gmeow-PlaceName.md)), add [`gmeow:usageAuthority`](../properties/gmeow-usageAuthority.md) for the toponymic authority and [`gmeow:usageInterval`](../properties/gmeow-usageInterval.md) for the period; the reasoner infers [`PlaceNaming`](gmeow-PlaceNaming.md), and the name's language reads from [`gmeow:nameLanguage`](../properties/gmeow-nameLanguage.md) on the bound [`PlaceName`](gmeow-PlaceName.md).

### Examples

- ex:naming a [`gmeow:NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md); [`gmeow:usageNamed`](../properties/gmeow-usageNamed.md) ex:istanbul; [`gmeow:usageAppellation`](../properties/gmeow-usageAppellation.md) ex:constantinopleName; [`gmeow:usageAuthority`](../properties/gmeow-usageAuthority.md) ex:ottomanAuthority; [`gmeow:usageInterval`](../properties/gmeow-usageInterval.md) ex:byzantineEra.
